fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) plunged 26% from $487 in early October, valued at 15.38x forward earnings; CEO assessed cutting-edge technology demand as "extremely robust."
fields.summary_ko.1: October 2026 revenue grew 59.7% year-over-year; despite Nvidia leadership instability and China export controls, customer diversification (Google, Amazon, etc.) and high switching costs maintain order demand.
